datasets.control_hz_provenance: Measured 2026-11-02 (ADR 0024): replaying all 75 episodes on the Isaac Lab 3.0 SO-101 asset with the course's actuator gains (course_actuators.json) reproduces the recorded states at 2 physics substeps of 1/120 s (pooled arm p95 0.71 LeRobot units, action-to-state lag 1.30 frames vs the dataset's own 1.34, sim-vs-recorded shift 0.01 frames) and runs ahead at 4 (p95 2.72, lag 0.47, shift +0.91). Consistent with the course's published code at ce807d9 (one frame per env.step of dt 1/120 x decimation 2), which postdates the dataset.
datasets.source: Training set of NVIDIA's Sim-to-Real SO-101 course (75 sim teleop episodes)
